CA.rationale: Content (red) and a processing-origin (history_estimate) are explicitly bound for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red) and an explicit origin/organization entry coexist and are separately present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing-origin labels (history_estimate, command_estimate) are explicitly tied to specific content referents, linking processing condition to content access/emergence.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries (color attributes with coordinate sets) identify represented content and attribute.

D.rationale: Content identification (red coordinates) is presented separately from organization/origin metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents map to display coordinates and includes explicit origin/organization metadata describing presentation/emergence.
